==Activities==

Ronja is an [[Aiel]] who has been blinded during the [[Last Battle]]. He also explains to [[Berelain]] that the [[gai'shain]] would never fight even if the [[Car'a'carn]] commanded.

== Trivia ==
*Ronja is named for Ronja John, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
